page.notes: The Hebrew phrase in § 1 (משקה רעהו) is copied from the scan. The Hebrew word after "vox" is too faint to read reliably and is marked illegible. The printed "socium,· aut" has a stray mark after the comma, which is treated as a comma. The long s is read as s throughout (e.g. "sit", "monstrat", "supplicio"), so "fit" is taken as "sit" from context. The "2." and "B." lines are an outline, copied as list lines. No marginal notes, no woodcut, no stamps.
